text:
Matthew Tkachuk played 31 games last season. This season he has 22 points in 16, and 18 are assists. The last ten have been absurd: 17 points with one goal, against about 10.9 we'd expect at his ice time. Our form check calls it earned, because Florida is creating more with him out there (16.9 on-ice expected goals against a usual 14.5).

Two oddities. His ice time is down about three minutes a night over that stretch, and the points keep coming anyway. And 13 of his points have come on the power play. Florida takes 59.2% of five-on-five shot attempts with him on, so this isn't only a special-teams story.

Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking has him carrying the puck in on 69% of his entries, though from just six tracked games. Evolving-Hockey had last season at 0.2 wins above replacement, a number from a 31-game year more than a verdict on the player.

Off the ice he's still himself: TSN's headline has him saying Brady's return to Ottawa "was not a sellout" despite what the Senators announced. Our range: 75 to 107 points.
headline: Tkachuk is passing his way back
